name: The Busy Med-Surg Shift
description: Students function as the RN responsible for a full med-surg assignment: receive shift report, review H&Ps and orders, assess, administer meds, respond to changes, delegate appropriately, and manage an unexpected admission.
notes: Her original case is one RN with five patients plus one admission. To run it with 3 students, duplicate this group or use tag counts (this library has red x4, yellow x1, green x1).
